title: Exemplary
content: Attended for a visit with the nurse. Staff were welcoming and friendly, even though they were extremely busy they managed to make me feel welcome and cared for. The appointment time was swift and on time. The nurse was friendly and helpful. Really put me at ease. Absolutely fantastic GP surgery and i cannot commend them enough for their efforts.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
